name: AB-CHMINACA

The same page explicitly warns it has not received full administrator review and may contain incorrect information, especially dosage and duration. These numbers are therefore not imported into structured dosage fields; they are recorded here with the source warning for traceability.

summary: AB-CHMINACA is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid and a potent agonist of the CB1 and CB2 receptors.
